name: Cacls (SA)
help: Reports file or directory access; Windows supports DACL details and wildcards.
long_help: On Windows, displays DACL entries for files and directories, including trustees, inheritance flags, and access rights, with wildcard support. On Linux and macOS, reports only whether one literal path exists and whether the current real UID/GID can read, write, and execute or search it. The POSIX implementation does not enumerate ACL entries, ownership, mode bits, or wildcards.

arguments.name: filepath
arguments.desc: File or directory path to list permissions for. Supports wildcards (e.g., C:\Windows\*.dll).
